51522191.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant FOXM1 DBD (222 to 360 residues) (unknown origin) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.SPR Analysis: 4.2. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) analysis SPR assays were performed using a Biacore T200 (GE Healthcare) at 25 °C. Recombinant FOXM1 (amino acids 222–360) protein (purity >90%, SDS page) was purchased from Genescript USA Inc. (NJ, China) and covalently immobilized on a CM5 sensor chip (GE Healthcare) via amine coupling. The running buffer was 1.0 × PBS + P (GE Healthcare). When the affinity screen of fragments was run, 5% DMSO was added to the buffer. Five to six concentrations of each fragment were used. Compounds were injected into the surface of the protein-coupled chip channels at a flow rate of 30 μL/min. The affinity (K_D) of XST20 was calibrated with the steady state affinity 1:1 binding model and the affinity (K_D) of S2 was calibrated with the kinetic fitting model. The affinities of the fragments were tested once in this study.
original_paragraph.Figure 3 caption: Fig. 3. Affinity and binding of S2 and XST20 to FOXM1. (A) The binding sensor gram of XST20 and the truncated protein FOXM1. (B) The binding sensor gram of S2 and the truncated protein FOXM1, K_D values are fitted by kinetics or affinity. (C–F) The schematic diagram of the molecular docking results of S2 and the lead compound XST20 on FOXM1: (C) The conformation of XST20 (blue) in the docking site. (D) The 2D interaction of XST20 and FOXM1 Schematic diagram of action. (E) The conformation of S2 (brown) in the docking site. (F) Schematic diagram of 2D interaction between S2 and FOXM1.

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 1.0 × PBS + P (GE Healthcare), with 5% DMSO added during fragment affinity screen
